name: hitl
description: Get human taste, judgment, and opinions for your AI agent. Submit requests for approval, option selection, ratings, or free-text opinions from a real human expert.

tools.name: check_hitl_status
tools.description: Check if the human reviewer is currently available, see pricing, queue depth, and operating hours. Always call this before submitting a request.

tools.name: ask_human_approval
tools.description: Ask the human to approve or reject something. Use for binary yes/no decisions. Costs $0.05 USDC. Returns the human's decision and optional reasoning.

title.description: Short title of what needs approval (max 100 chars)

agent_context.description: What your agent is doing and why it needs approval

tools.name: ask_human_choice
tools.description: Ask the human to choose between 2-6 options. Use for design decisions, direction choices, or preference selection. Costs $0.10 USDC.

title.description: What decision needs to be made (max 100 chars)

tools.name: ask_human_opinion
tools.description: Ask the human for their free-text opinion, taste, or strategic input. Use when you need subjective human judgment that AI cannot provide. Costs $0.25 USDC.

title.description: What you need the human's opinion on (max 100 chars)

agent_context.description: What your agent is working on

tools.name: ask_human_rating
tools.description: Ask the human to rate something on a 1-5 scale. Use for quality assessment, relevance scoring, or priority evaluation. Costs $0.05 USDC.

tools.name: vote_expertise
tools.description: Vote for an expertise area you need, or propose a new one. High-demand categories get prioritized by the human operator.

category_slug.description: Slug of existing category to vote for

proposed_name.description: Name of a new expertise category to propose

use_case.description: Your specific use case for this expertise

willingness_to_pay.description: How much you'd pay per request in USDC

resources.name: service_info
resources.description: Full documentation of the HITL service, capabilities, and API
